knowledge.name: Frozen synthetic procurement snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled requests, vendors, ratings, terms, approval thresholds, budgets, and spend records provide deterministic review evidence.

knowledge.name: Procurement rules and guardrails
knowledge.detail: Uploaded rules define evidence anchors, review gates, required disclosures, missing-evidence handling, and prohibited purchasing actions.

intelligence_processing.name: Purchase-request review
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes synthetic request context, amount, justification, budget code, status, preferred vendor evidence, and applicable reviewer.

intelligence_processing.name: Vendor evidence comparison
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares synthetic vendor category, tier, rating, annual spend, and payment terms neutrally without selecting or endorsing a supplier.

intelligence_processing.name: Approval-path recommendation
intelligence_processing.detail: Matches a synthetic request amount to the recorded authorization threshold, approver, and SLA without recording an approval.

intelligence_processing.name: Spend and budget review
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates category utilization and highlights over-budget or at-risk synthetic spend for authorized finance and procurement review.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language review for procurement managers, category buyers, department approvers, and finance directors.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file ProcurementAgent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with bundled synthetic data and no credentials.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first review responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Presents exact synthetic evidence, prerequisites, control gaps, missing inputs, and the authorized human or workflow review required next.

management_reporting.name: Purchase request and approval brief
management_reporting.detail: Reports request identity, amount, status, justification, budget code, required approver, threshold, and review SLA.

management_reporting.name: Neutral vendor comparison report
management_reporting.detail: Shows vendor ratings, tiers, terms, and annual spend as comparison evidence that is explicitly not a supplier award.

management_reporting.name: Budget pressure and control review
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes total and category budgets, spent and committed amounts, availability, trends, and review priorities before more spend.

tools.name: Portable RAPP Procurement Agent
tools.detail: Single-file ProcurementAgent implements four read-only review operations with bundled synthetic data and no external credentials.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the conversational package with two knowledge files and four skills; validated and exported agents remain unpublished Drafts.

tools.name: Power Platform CLI
tools.detail: Initializes, pulls, validates, pushes, and exports the CLI-authored package while publication remains a separate approved step.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 procurement and finance
tools.detail: Approved production seam for governed request and finance data; the current package has no connection reference or live-system access.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams approvals
tools.detail: Approved collaboration seam for authenticated human review; no approval, message, routing, or supplier action is configured.

tools.name: Foundation model selected by environment
tools.detail: The deployment environment supplies conversational routing and generation; preview evidence records Claude Sonnet 4.6.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic review operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes purchase-request, vendor-comparison, approval-routing, and spend-analysis intents to operation-specific evidence.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only grounding
supporting_features.detail: Uses only two bundled knowledge files and forbids browsing, supplier queries, enrichment, or invention of missing procurement facts.

supporting_features.name: Evidence-first response contract
supporting_features.detail: Requires exact request, amount, vendor, category, or threshold evidence plus prerequisites, control gaps, and the next human review.

supporting_features.name: Human authorization gates
supporting_features.detail: Preserves budget, legal, security, competition, diversity, conflict, business-owner, and explicit publication reviews.

supporting_features.name: Non-transactional purchasing boundary
supporting_features.detail: Provides procurement review only: no request or purchase-order write, supplier contact or selection, terms acceptance, or funds commitment.

supporting_features.name: Locked case and isolation validation
supporting_features.detail: Maintains one persona-language case per operation and records four passing strict-isolation and Copilot Studio preview cases.

supporting_features.name: Draft and export controls
supporting_features.detail: Packages an unmanaged export with no connection references, keeps the agent unpublished, and requires administrator review before publish.
